title: Setup: Notification Preferences and permission-set assignments are titled by raw user ids, not the person's name
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-25** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Setup → Configuration → Notification Preferences; a user's Permission Sets tab.
- **Actual:** the Notification Preferences list and record title read like `ISu3jHPIrdgD45L1rrC2FuE7DIcsk2ap · urgent_task · inbox`. A `sys_user_permission_set` record is titled `<raw user id> → qa_fls_rep`.
- **Expected:** a record that names a person shows the person's name, as every lookup elsewhere does.
- **Evidence:** [`32-config-notification-preferences-created.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/32-config-notification-preferences-created.png).
- **class:** a (UX defect: an admin cannot tell whose record it is). **Reach:** every admin.

## Seat review

- **Scope:** the finding's first half, the raw id in Record Shares' *Recipient* column, is objectstack#24701 (open), and the measurement is added there. This card is the other two objects.
- **Landing:** `service-messaging` `sys_notification_preference` and `sys_user_permission_set` compose their titles from the raw user id.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 4 hits in objectstack, 4 in objectui. objectstack#24701 (open) covers the record-share recipient only. **New** for these two objects.
